newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Market quiet, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Market quiet, prices mixed.

text.p: U.S. millfeed markets were quiet Tuesday and prices were mixed, dealers said.
Most sales were for prompt delivery. Feed mixers continue to resist buying large quantities or for deferred shipment because of the ample supplies of competing feed ingredients, they said.
With the winter wheat harvest advancing north and producing good yields, wheat was displacing other ingredients in feed rations, dealers said .
In the Carolinas, the wheat harvest was winding down and dealers reported good yields and quality from the crop.
Some millfeed offers were unchanged to higher because of reduced production during this U.S. Independence Day holiday week. The holiday is Friday.
